sentences.text:
By way of the present petition, the petitioners seek quashing of FIR bearing No. 140/2023,
registered at Police Station Nihal Vihar, Outer District, Delhi for the commission of offence punishable under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (hereafter 'IPC').
The learned APP accepts notice on behalf of the State and seeks time to file the Status Report.

Let the same be filed, at least two days prior to the next date of hearing, with an advance copy to the other side.
3. Issue notice to respondent no. 2 through the concerned Investigating Officer (I.O.) for the next date of hearing.
4. List on 27.01.2026.
5.
The order be uploaded on the website forthwith.
DR. SWARANA KANTA SHARMA, J DECEMBER 02, 2025/
